description: This file contains unit tests for the OAuthClientAPI class within the OAuth plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations such as getAll, getOne, update, and delete, using mock objects and data providers.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the OAuthClientAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin, focusing on CRUD operations for OAuth clients.
